## About

I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Business Analytics and Information Systems at the Williams College of Business, Xavier University.

My research examines operational decision-making in digital platforms, service systems, supply chains, and technology-enabled markets. I use analytical modeling to study platform operations, service design, pricing, congestion, artificial intelligence, and strategic interactions among firms and customers.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5809-3092){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Research Areas

- Platform and service operations
- Operations and supply chain management
- Pricing and revenue management
- Artificial intelligence in operations
- Game theory and economic modeling
- Logistics and last-mile delivery

Collaborations are always welcome. Please feel free to reach out to me via email at jaganjacob91@gmail.com
